title: Qualify bounded TORCH-building-TORCH development loop
description: The installed smoke proved only one specialist and one manager communicating. Plan an approved bounded code task across specialists: current brief; assigned/resume preference; checks; frozen queued evidence where appropriate; serialized landing on the approved rewrite boundary; landed closure; next-item/idle; stop/resume. Preserve all worktree history and clarify remote/local recoverability before landing.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact code commit and required gates are recorded on the actual merged tree
No direct main push races or PR bypass occurs; landing conflicts return to the author
Live model behavior follows fresh per-item instructions and one active assignment
Stop/resume retains identity and mid-flight work; budget is enforced
